rule: ship-allowed: the licence lets what is derived from it go into the app, and what the licence asks for (a name, a licence, a note that it was changed) is done where the app shows it. reference-only: looked at, measured or learned from; nothing of it is in the app. rejected: not used, with the reason. A source that is not in this file is not used.

sources.what: The canonical cat: mesh, rest pose, colours ("Fluffy Blue-Eyed Cat (all animations)", Meshy AI)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (the owner's statement of 2026-10-21; Meshy's own page was not checked: see reports/kino-cat/06-risk-and-license-register.md)
sources.usedFor: cat.mesh and model.ts (simplified, re-skinned onto the engine's 32-bone skeleton, colours baked into the vertices); the model's own clips are NOT shipped, its own walk was only traced to see how the body rocks (reference-only)
sources.attribution: cat.settings.credit (en/ro/it), shown on the cat's settings page

sources.what: Fourteen hand-made quadruped animations on one fox skeleton (Mesh2Motion)
sources.licence: CC0 1.0 for the assets, models, rigs and animations; MIT for the program
sources.usedFor: walk, run and yawn: the fox's joint turns are put on the cat's bones (scripts/cat/anim/retarget.mts, recipes/mesh2motion.mts), then given the style of a cat, planted on the floor and thinned; nothing of the fox's model is used
sources.attribution: none asked for; named in docs/cat-animation/SOURCES.md

sources.what: "Fox" of the glTF Sample Assets: Survey, Walk, Run
sources.licence: model CC0 1.0 (PixelMannen); rigging and animation CC BY 4.0 (tomkranis); conversion to glTF CC BY 4.0 (@AsoboStudio and @scurest)
sources.usedFor: stand (the Survey animation put on the cat's bones, as above); nothing of the fox's model is used
sources.attribution: cat.settings.credit (en/ro/it): the animation's maker, the converters, the licence, "changed to fit"

sources.what: The cats of Quaternius's animated animals packs (two files, 2022 and 2023)
sources.usedFor: nothing: looked at as donors of a cat's gait; the rigs are too crude (one bone for each leg, 4 to 16 bones in all) to drive the cat's four-bone legs

sources.what: A search for a better canonical cat: 50 Objaverse models (cc0 or by, from 798,759 scanned), 2 Quaternius, 10 Poly Pizza (CC BY 3.0), Poly Haven, Wikimedia Commons, OpenGameArt
sources.licence: CC0 or CC BY only were kept
sources.usedFor: nothing: none came near the Meshy cat (the best two scored 4 of 5 on a clay render, and are low-poly); recorded so that the search is not repeated

sources.what: MoCapAnything (arXiv 2604.28130): motion capture of any skeleton from video
sources.usedFor: nothing: its reported joint error (about 23 degrees) is more than a cat's leg chain can take
